newsitem.title: FINLAND: Rautaruukki rises on steel price outlook.
newsitem.headline: Rautaruukki rises on steel price outlook.

text.p: Finnish steel group Rautaruukki Oy rose to a 21-month high in active trade on Tuesday cheered partly by brighter prospects for steel prices, and by firm eight-month earnings for engineering group Valmet, brokers said.
At 1205/0905 GMT, Rautaruukki traded at 41.30 markka, up 1.30 markka or 3.25 percent. Volume was fair for Rautaruukki at almost three million markka.
"The whole metal sector is rallying and particularly Rautaruukki is helped by better stainless steel price prospects," one broker said.
Brokers said Valmet's slightly higher-than-forecast January-August earnings reported on Tuesday helped give an additional boost to the metal sector.

Rautaruukki announced on September 27 it expected its full-year 1996 profit before extraordinary items and tax to be lower than in 1995. But brokers said, this evidently did not have any impact on the share.
"All that anyone really cares about is the outlook for steel prices," one noted. An international steel congress under way in Helsinki has painted bright prospects of rising steel prices.
